review_reference: Backend release backend-40640255055-1-02b120fc1ecb1889 from production-backend-images run 40640255055 (D-Eminence/hid-system#124 at be1bad5, identity-api and notification-api only, no migration, deployed 2026-10-28). Browser-facing changes since the previous pins: patient sessions last 7 days idle and 30 days at most; POST /api/v1/identity/patient-enrollments/activate signs the patient in on the login path and answers signedIn; POST /api/v1/auth/patient/login answers 403 ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED for a suspended patient with the right password; welcome, reset-code and password-updated emails in hid-1.0's design. This frontend (D-Eminence/health#23, merged as 82e6d2e) uses each where it is answered and keeps working without. The other services stay on the commits they run. Reviewed and approved by the repository owner, D-Eminence, in chat on 2026-10-28 (batch approval for this parity work).
